title: Engine Emission Control: PCV Valve Location
introduction:
I use this drawing to find the positive crankcase ventilation (PCV) valve. Follow the callout line to the blue-highlighted fitting entering the camshaft cover below the intake manifold. The curved hose above it provides another landmark; match the callout with the description table to confirm the component's identity.

Some combustion gas passes the piston rings into the crankcase; this is called blow-by. Ventilation carries those gases away to limit pressure and contamination buildup. Think of the PCV valve as a metered exit: it regulates vapor flow toward the intake, while the hose provides the route.

This reference establishes location and identity. It does not determine valve condition or provide access and removal instructions. For service work, use the [engine-specific PCV valve procedure](#/document/G1691476).

edits.why: The engine label establishes which configuration this location drawing applies to.
